picks.file: Emarat Chahar Borj, Urmieh, Qajar period.png
picks.what: View over the town’s rooftops to the walled Chahar Borj (Four Towers) building, photograph
picks.why: only true town view; flat roofs, walls and corner towers of the Chahar Borj; date field 1300 is the Hijri year (1882–83), and a sibling photo from the same Ali Khan Vali album is filed under 1883 in Iran

gaps: P0–P3: nothing (the P0/P3 hits are Hijri-dated photos and portraits); P5: only crowds, refugees, the lake and a mission building; P6: only satellite photos of Lake Urmia
notes: The 1904 city-gate photo (#10) is a faded funeral-procession scene; the 1911 Bain photos are crowd scenes.
